_comment: Venues for the withdrawal-ability recorder (scripts/record-venue-liquidity.mjs). These are EXTERNAL mainnet venues (Ethereum), read via RECORDER_RPC_URL — NOT the local anvil. Entry shape: {name, kind, address, underlying?, decimals, enabled, newsQuery?, notes, depthMarkets?, depthCoveredByInstant?}. Only enabled=true venues are recorded. Never guess an address; leave it empty and enabled=false until verified. newsQuery (optional) is the Google News RSS search string for scripts/fetch-venue-news.mjs — a plain-English venue name, NOT a ticker, so headlines are about the protocol, not a random symbol collision.
_comment_depth: depthMarkets (optional) = the DEPTH-VS-BOOK extension (memo P4, docs/research/worst-carry-venues.md §3). Two-sided-pool entry {name, kind:'curve-stableswap'|'uniswap-v3', address, token0, token1, exitFrom, enabled, note}: token0/token1 are coins(0)/coins(1) (curve) or token0()/token1() (univ3); exitFrom = the token a holder is exiting (venue token, or its UNDERLYING when the venue token has no deep pool); EXITABLE depth = the OTHER side (tokens you swap INTO). psm-buffer entry {name, kind:'psm-buffer', address (the DAI/USDC PSM), wrapper (the public USDS/USDC route), buffer (Pocket address), bufferToken (swap-INTO token), exitFrom, enabled, note}: only matched same-block wrapper psm()/pocket()/usds(), PSM pocket()/gem()/tout(), and token balance/decimals yield exit depth; halted buyGem yields 0, unknown route or fee yields null. Pocket balance remains raw shared inventory, not a holder quote. When a venue has MULTIPLE enabled markets, depth_usd SUMS their exitable USD and depth_skew_pct = the WORST (max) pool one-sidedness. EVERY address is on-chain-verified before enabled=true; a candidate that fails verification stays enabled=false with a note. depthCoveredByInstant=true (aave) means the venue's instant_usd read already IS its depth. A venue with neither an enabled depthMarket nor depthCoveredByInstant keeps 'depth_vs_book' on its uncovered list. termsUrl (optional) = the EXACT official redemption/terms page the terms-hash watcher (scripts/watch-venue-terms.mjs) tracks; its presence drops 'terms_page_changes' from the uncovered list.

venues.name: sUSDe
venues.notes: Ethena Staked USDe (mainnet). underlying = USDe. Reads: cooldownDuration() uint24, totalAssets(), totalSupply(), silo() if present. cooling/stranded split is venue-specific and NOT fabricated here — raw params stored, instant_usd left null with a note.

depthMarkets.name: DOLA/sUSDe (Curve stableswap-ng)
depthMarkets.note: VERIFIED on-chain 2026-09-06: coins(0)=DOLA (symbol DOLA, 18dec), coins(1)=sUSDe (symbol sUSDe, 18dec); balances ~$40.8M DOLA / ~$12.4M sUSDe (~$53M TVL). NO deep sUSDe/USDe or sUSDe/USDC Curve or Uni-v3 pool exists on mainnet (Curve registry scan: best sUSDe/USDC is ~$718 dust). This DOLA/sUSDe pool is sUSDe's DEEPEST secondary (instant-exit) market. exitFrom=sUSDe ⇒ exitable depth = the DOLA side (swap sUSDe INTO DOLA), valued $1/stable as a stated assumption (DOLA is Inverse Finance's stablecoin).

venues.name: aave-v3-usde
venues.notes: aEthUSDe, VERIFIED on-chain 2026-09-02: Aave V3 Pool (0x87870Bca…4fA4E2).getReserveData(USDe) returned this address; it answers symbol()='aEthUSDe' and UNDERLYING_ASSET_ADDRESS()=USDe. instant liquidity = USDe.balanceOf(aToken) at $1/stable (assumption recorded in params). depthCoveredByInstant=true: for an aToken the instant_usd read (underlying held by the aToken) IS the exitable depth, so no secondary pool is needed and 'depth_vs_book' is NOT on this venue's uncovered list. variableDebtToken = 0x015396E1…465145, VERIFIED on-chain 2026-09-06 from Pool.getReserveData(USDe) word 10: symbol()='variableDebtEthUSDe' (contains 'variableDebt') and UNDERLYING_ASSET_ADDRESS()=USDe. utilization_pct = variableDebt.totalSupply()/(that + underlyingBalance)*100 (debt $285.8M, avail $360.9M => 44.2% at verification) — the utilization alarm (watch >90/alarm >95) reads it.

venues.name: sGHO
venues.notes: Aave Staked GHO, Ethereum mainnet. Identity from the existing GHO_SGHO exact-leg route, independently VERIFIED at finalized block 26079542 (hash 0x1b47777dc539151fe1bc12cb67837eaaab1815414fa261a7bc1fd441ccfb682f): vault.asset()=GHO, vault/GHO decimals=18, paused()=false, totalAssets and totalSupply readable, GHO.balanceOf(vault) readable. Deposit and Withdraw ERC-4626 signatures each appeared 16 times in the preceding 5000 finalized blocks. instant_usd is raw vault GHO cash at an explicit $1/GHO assumption only while asset/decimals/pause reads verify; it is an aggregate upper bound, not a wallet maxWithdraw or executable quote. When paused, effective instant_usd is zero and raw cash remains recorded. No secondary-market depth is represented.

venues.name: sUSDS
venues.notes: Sky Savings USDS, VERIFIED on-chain 2026-09-02: symbol()='sUSDS', asset()=USDS (0xdC03…384F), totalAssets ~$4.7B at verification. No cooldown method — those reads fail gracefully and raw 4626 state (totalAssets/totalSupply) is what gets recorded. termsUrl = https://sky.money/susds (docs.sky.money/susds 404'd per dossier).

depthMarkets.name: USDS→USDC via Sky LitePSM (MCD_LITE_PSM_USDC_A)
depthMarkets.note: Sky documents public USDS→USDC via UsdsPsmWrapper 0xA188…f98c, routing internally through DAI↔USDC LitePSM 0xf6e72…3042 (https://developers.skyeco.com/guides/psm/litepsm/). Executable depth is published only after pinned same-block wrapper psm()/pocket()/usds(), PSM pocket()/gem(), and USDC Pocket balance/decimals reads all match this configured route. Pocket cash remains a shared aggregate inventory, never sUSDS-holder-specific capacity or a guaranteed quote.

depthMarkets.name: USDS/USDC (none deep enough — UNVERIFIED, not enabled)
depthMarkets.note: NO verifiable deep USDS/USDC (or sUSDS) Curve/Uni-v3 pool exists on mainnet (Curve registry + DeFiLlama scan 2026-09-06: best USDS/USDC Curve pool ~$4k dust). Deep USDS DEX liquidity lives in Uniswap v4 (PYUSD-USDS ~$100M, USDT-USDS ~$50M) — a singleton PoolManager the reader cannot address by pool contract — and Sky's PSM (a peg-stability module, not an AMM). Left enabled:false: never guess an address. Consequence: sUSDS keeps 'depth_vs_book' on its uncovered list until a v4-capable reader or a verified curve/univ3 pool is added.
